## Problem and changes

Incoming workbench services own per-project workers, cancellation, queued builds and application launch. Project18's structured project compiler must run through those owners so background graph compilation retains the selected project, produces real dependency envelopes, and rejects stale results.

This complete eleven-file batch adds the optional raw-worker compiler contribution and its StudioProjectCompiler adapter, composes StudioProjects/StudioExecution, invalidates reverse dependencies and scopes loading diagnostics to each project's active target framework. Explicit workbench arguments/environment retain precedence over project defaults. The existing graph runner still owns target order and artifact reuse; no separate graph evaluator or worker protocol is introduced.

Seven project-composition cases exercise the raw worker port, cancellation and revision fencing, a real two-project compilation with emitted dependency envelopes, reverse invalidation, launch precedence and the native execution boundary. The five existing diagnostic-producer cases retain all original warning/error/isolation assertions. Their obsolete unsupported-multi-TFM warning trigger is replaced by a real duplicate-import warning; context identity is asserted explicitly.

## Actual dependencies

Base `codex/p18-workbench-build-dependencies`, head `f7c2fafa10c66b45ff69039433e382c9ad13a1d2`, exact tree `17ef4bbf7d67712393f571656802ec738e95bc72`, is a pure dependency join of:

| Published parent | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| #3883 `eabf6b88a91b262b54f8b8c28efb95ef5fbf4c1d` | Structured project build/session contracts |
| #3956 `05d4c991a132643ce05248c7f42f3b2b0f168c70` | Verified compiler/runtime graph envelope and pinned-main workbench |

After both prerequisite stacks land, retarget to main or the remaining dependency. Keep merge commits so dependents retain ancestry. The join contains only the owner-reviewed archive/API/selector unions needed to combine those actual parents.

## Qualification

All **7/7** new project-composition cases and **5/5** diagnostic-producer cases passed in the scheduled Node26.10.0 replay at corrected source `7b087e0f0e3105c71ec86e39554358766b45d3bf`. The enclosing 38-file run is **259 passed / 260 total, one failed**, with the remaining failure in the native resource-staleness wrapper. The initial canonical source `bb2b8d84c8dfc0b14fc76b2c605b84d48a1e993e` retains its full **1809/1875 passed, 66 failed** evidence; it is not relabelled as green.

Commands use `node scripts/limited.js`; exact logs/argv are retained by root in the synchronized and correction qualification captures, with per-file attribution in `workbench-port-qualification.json`. No local tests, build, benchmark or full CI dispatch was repeated for this projection. Automatic required core is pending. This is source-qualified workbench component evidence; protected Studio entry execution, browser/Windows targets and full-tree qualification remain explicit separate boundaries. No performance improvement is claimed.

## Source provenance

All eight product/fixture blobs match corrected canonical `7b087e0f0e3105c71ec86e39554358766b45d3bf` exactly; the contract file documents the public composition contract. Preserved local projection `96fea5fe6e2c94e9fa550ad53ed9619b2756dbc4`; published `d139d6dfbbe5c0922c5087d38a3ddd31217eff6a`; exact local/remote tree `138fea83ca2e0135cb89d99f40ff0933c59ade99`. Git Data API readback proves the full tree and parent. No protected Studio entry or root manifest feature edit is included.


## Observed core correction

The first required core run `37179732776` rejected the projected scope because `apps/studio/project-runtime-input.js` had not been published with its canonical consumer. That failure log is preserved. Forward commit `6863a10cbf07d5d2a412afe3b8f231de9f260902` includes the exact 30-line canonical envelope adapter and its three existing positive/negative/boundary cases, plus its public contract documentation. The adapter is unchanged from `7b087e0f0e3105c71ec86e39554358766b45d3bf` and final source `5269d3970f10fee404ef23e5fe3d07cb61d8750c`; it rejects incomplete/oversized PE envelopes before worker transport and consumes the already-published public bytecode reference limits.

All three envelope cases passed in the initial completed canonical Node26 scope. The projected build scope's 38 direct relative/package imports were reviewed against the staged tree; no other missing direct prerequisite remains. The current exact tree is `405a475104c176cf8abcbd1a2a0e3a53a3156174`, preserved local correction `172fa9e6c9f2ecb9d9779d2f5500a1ab08b62f4c`, first parent `d139d6dfbbe5c0922c5087d38a3ddd31217eff6a`. The required automatic core check will re-evaluate this complete forward correction. No local test/build was repeated and the earlier aggregate failures remain part of the evidence.

4407.body:
## Why this batch is needed

Project 18's workspace/archive/wizard services must enter through the incoming workbench's document and workspace owners. This standalone composition module makes that boundary explicit before the protected Studio entry is applied.

## Changes

- Lazily compose the existing workspace session with Documents, workbench context, provider saves, release and save-conflict callbacks.
- Admit closed C# sources once, retaining immutable source/model/encoding descriptors without reading the compatibility text getter; reject cancellation or a changed workspace before adoption.
- Route recovery, legacy/streaming ZIP export, strict empty-folder saves, project/solution entry actions and existing-project import to their existing owners.
- Preserve picker/sink ownership, the current disk provider and read-only wizard rejection before mutation.

The batch contains **3 files / 479 added lines**, including public host-contract documentation and five existing focused cases. Product/test bytes exactly match corrected source `7b087e0f`, final `5269d397` and legacy-cleanup source `e9f8a8cd`. This projection leaves the protected `studio.js` entry unchanged. Its proposed P18 wiring remains unapplied and unexecuted; the root's separate actual-entry browser runs are recorded independently.

## Actual dependency stack

Base `codex/p18-workbench-workspace-dependencies` at `1e410e82601e9659235a9ad8dd116e85ebd39e4c` joins actual published #4361 (prepared session/save), #4306 (prepared ingress), #3910 (wizard), #3792 (current XAML/chrome), #4360 (prepared persistence/interchange), #3629 (recovery bootstrap) and #3835 (disk event host).

The dependency joins preserve actual parents and owner-reviewed public API/documentation unions. The final union restores the streaming package star export already present in #3788 and #4306, which the automatic merge with the extracted project facade had dropped; removing redundant explicit archive bindings makes that facade shrink. No producer code was copied or changed.

After those foundations land, retarget this draft to main or the remaining dependency. The helper's consumer wiring remains a separate protected-entry integration.

## Qualification and source correction

- The five focused workspace-port cases passed the corrected root Node 26 replay at `7b087e0f`.
- Final root Node 22.23.3 scope at `5269d397`: **1,877/1,877 passed**, including all five cases, with zero failures/skips/cancellations.
- The initial broad Node 26 run remains recorded as **1,809/1,875**, and the later replay as **259/260**. The original workspace-port result was 4/5: the failing assertion read an unexposed disposal field. Its corrected case verifies the public live-model and owner-disposal behavior while retaining all source, identity, encoding and lazy-getter assertions.
- Static source inspection followed **36 host modules and 91 named imports** against their actual public export closures, with zero missing names. No repository JavaScript, tests or builds were executed for this projection.
- Required `core` passed on this exact draft: [run 37182178812](https://github.com/wieslawsoltes/SharpForge/actions/runs/37182178812), job 111376788666. Module qualification does not claim protected-entry or full browser flow qualification.

## Provenance

Complete projection source: `440f218c269724b4dc271d4a00793fc9fddab522`.

3792.body:
## Current qualification

Required `core` passed for current head `02bdce19441b36240faf5fafdaef6149619d1dce`: [run 37181105732](https://github.com/wieslawsoltes/SharpForge/actions/runs/37181105732), job 111373699623. The canonical full Node 22.23.3 scope at `5269d397` passed **1,877/1,877**; the exact legacy cleanup at `e9f8a8cd` passed **382/382** Node 26 cases and check/build/clean-checkout.

The actual canonical Release13 browser run at `362f1337` passed three checks before an obsolete textarea `.fill` fixture failed to replace the virtual editor document. With the keyboard/selection fixture at `7d558dab`, five checks passed, including designer modes, minimal source edits, real source input and undo/redo. Shortening the document then exposed a real stale status-column `RangeError`; its owner is correcting that defect before the root's next full replay. Neither run completed the full suite. The private proposed Studio entry remains unapplied and unexecuted; these browser observations are from the actual canonical entry. Windows-only native target execution remains unqualified here.

The earlier source-qualified results and failed aggregates below are preserved as historical records.

## Problem and changes

A generated project must retain editable XAML after ZIP or folder reopening, then survive a designer edit, another export, and a second connection. This focused regression exercises the existing public archive, provider, template, and designer services through all three transports: ordinary ZIP, Blob ZIP64, and a selected folder.

The generated packaged-project fixture preserves UTF-16BE, BOM and CRLF for XAML/manifests, leaves code-behind unchanged, and keeps PNG assets byte-identical. A real `DesignDocument` and `DesignerSourceSync` apply a TextBlock edit through the source-preserving markup service before the second round trip.

## Dependency DAG

The original feature was one new 94-line test; the reviewed pinned-main compatibility update below preserves that feature and adds its required source-sync composition. Its base `codex/p18-xaml-reopen-dependencies` is a **pure dependency join**, with no additional implementation changes:

| Ordered parent | Published SHA | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `codex/p18-wizard-dependencies` | `065212895ef9152c5daa3adf17d57fc619a2c961` | Existing archive/destinations, template catalog, designer markup, and provider disk foundations (#3565, #3574, #3578, #3652 and their stacks) |
| `codex/p18-xml-text-policy` | `6ff88b293117bf7e0b636a7a7b8877deb08fe604` | Shared editable XAML/manifest policy, #3781 |

The join's remote SHA is `fd39e656de9e3a4651b8823cb30e866dc71ed2f2`, exact tree `ccda700b7cbabeadcc04f71aab35df7208fdd8cd`, preserved source `cc1717ed9d488cca7e59e67200953bd5131da4fa`. It carries both published parents so this draft's diff does not duplicate the prerequisite implementations. After both prerequisite stacks land, retarget this draft to `main` (or the remaining dependency until then); merge commits preserve dependent history.

Related work: #3214, #3218.

## Qualification and boundaries

All **three** cases in `tests/a24-xaml-reopen.test.js` passed with Node **26.10.0**, Linux, in the complete scheduled host cohort at integration source `8e2941662234e607018f39a3f6d2cadddb2730a0`. The command used `node scripts/limited.js node --test --test-concurrency=1 --test-reporter=tap` with the complete host file list.

The enclosing run reported **495 passed / 500 total**; its five failures are outside this file and are being corrected in the host integration scope. Full argv, environment, timings and results are retained in `planning/evidence/project18/integration/upstream-qualification/node26-host-complete.json` and its adjacent TAP log. No additional broad tests were repeated for publication. Automatic PR `core` was pending when this original qualification record was written; the current exact-head result is above.

This is public-service component qualification. The protected full-Studio entry wiring and actual Windows App SDK builds/runtime remain separately qualified boundaries; generating a Windows project here does not claim a Windows build.

The regression file is copied byte-for-byte from the integration source. Git Data API tree creation and commit readback verified the entire feature tree and the join's ordered parents.

## Pinned-main compatibility update

This branch now has a normal forward merge preserving the previously published head `aead2cc90a24b7780753d490a548826a9756dd39` as its first parent and pinned main `1db2e1d540a78403b7aaddcf472311fcde1a81ef` as its second parent. No newer main was fetched. The existing stack remains intact.

The two designer source files exactly match canonical composed source `bb2b8d84c8dfc0b14fc76b2c605b84d48a1e993e`:

- `apps/studio/designer-source-sync.js` retains the modular public facade.
- `apps/studio/designer/source-sync.js` combines XAML and closed-record source editing with incoming diagnostic publication/clearing, stale chooser and timer guards, and post-await source ownership checks.

The other manual resolutions are owner-reviewed public API unions: descriptor-preserving archive extraction and settings, ZIP modes/timestamps and modular destination APIs; incoming source-aware default disk APIs alongside the additive provider APIs; and the extracted Workspace facade with incoming `sourceModel(options)`. Auto-merged upstream code retains its incoming behavior. The protected Studio entry is the exact pinned-main blob; its prepared P18 wiring remains a separate, unexecuted text proposal.

The original three XAML reopen cases and incoming designer ownership cases are included in the canonical completed-scope qualification. The enclosing current run at `bb2b8d84c8dfc0b14fc76b2c605b84d48a1e993e` reports **1809 passed / 1875 total, 66 failed**. The project-context diagnostic adapter and other affected corrections are being replayed by their owners; this update does not claim whole-tree qualification or full-Studio/browser/Windows execution. No local test or build was repeated for this projection. The compatibility head's required core passed in run 37179275513; the later cleanup head's result is recorded above.

This forward commit keeps the existing draft's complete history and moves the mode transition body into `designer/chrome-mode.js`. C# and XAML editor opening, split docking, preview resizing and sync rendering retain their existing order. The legacy file now decreases from the pinned main's 37 to 35 lines, 11,771 to 10,516 bytes and maximum line length 1,845 to 1,384. The new helper is 43 lines with a 108-character maximum.
